summary: The diff implements all three requirements. A login button with Internet Identity integration was added to the Header component. The button appears for unauthenticated users with prominent styling, triggers authentication on click with loading state, and is hidden when users are authenticated while showing logout controls.

hallucinated_features.description: Error handling logic for 'User is already authenticated' scenario with automatic clear and retry
hallucinated_features.reason: The diff includes try-catch error handling in handleAuth that specifically catches and handles a 'User is already authenticated' error by clearing state and retrying login after 300ms delay. This error recovery mechanism was not specified in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Query client cache clearing on logout
hallucinated_features.reason: The implementation includes queryClient.clear() call on logout, clearing all React Query cached data. This cache management behavior was not requested in the BuildRequest requirements.
